description:
Convert a curl command (bash/zsh quoting, $'...' strings, \ line continuations, or Windows cmd ^ escaping from 'Copy as cURL') into JavaScript fetch, Node Axios, Python requests, Go net/http or PHP ext-curl. Follows curl semantics: -d implies POST with application/x-www-form-urlencoded, repeated -d joins with &, --json sets JSON headers, -G moves data to the query string, -F is multipart, -u is Basic auth, no redirects without -L. Nothing is sent over the network.

Returns: Text: the generated code, followed by notes on anything not translated. structuredContent { code, method, url, headers[{ name, value }], hasBody, warnings[] }.
Example input: {"command":"curl -X POST https://api.example.com/v1/items -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"name\":\"Ada\"}'","target":"python"}
On error, includes hint: Send the command exactly as copied, including quotes. The word curl must be present.
name: curl_to_code
title: cURL to code
